outcome: Usage totals stay correct for accounts whose usage exceeds a 32-bit integer.

expected_verification.assertion: units are totalled per account id

acceptance_criteria.text: The column widening can be applied to the live usage table without holding an exclusive lock for the length of a table rewrite.

expected_verification.assertion: the migration applies to a populated usage_events table without a full-table exclusive lock

data_impact: Rewrites every row of the largest table in the schema.
rollout: Migration applied ahead of the application release.
rollback: Narrowing back to integer would fail on any row that has since exceeded the range.
